newsitem.title: USA: Sun Media Corp issues $90 million in 144A debt.
newsitem.headline: Sun Media Corp issues $90 million in 144A debt.

text.p: The following 144A debt issue from Sun Media Corp was priced in the U.S. high-yield market on Wednesday, according to a syndicate source.

Proceeds from the deal will be used in conjunction with bank borrowings to acquire assets of The London Free Press and Netmar Inc, both Canadian newspaper publishers. Based in Toronto, Ontario, Sun Media publishes urban and community newspapers, shopping guides and other specialty publications primarily in Canada.
Sun Media is a subsidiary of Sun Media Inc.
CIBC Wood Gundy Securities was lead manager on the deal.
